title: Keep it
vo: Now you have one jar, about 150 grams. Keep it on the worktop and feed it every 12 hours, or keep it in the fridge and feed it once a week. Feed it the evening before you bake, and use it when it has doubled.
voUS: Now you have one jar, about 5 ounces. Keep it on the worktop and feed it every 12 hours, or keep it in the fridge and feed it once a week. Feed it the evening before you bake, and use it when it has doubled.
cap: One jar, about 150 g. On the worktop, feed it every 12 hours.
In the fridge, feed it once a week.
